_comment: The Warden's skills, learned by level. 'ability' is the pack asset under Example scene/Scripts/AbilitySystem/Abilities Active/ (without .asset). Two can be carried into a fight at once; the dodge is always on its own button.

desc.en: A ring of hearth-fire bursts out around the Warden and scorches everything close.
desc.id: Lingkaran api perapian meledak di sekitar Warden dan membakar semua yang dekat.

desc.en: A low, dirty slash that keeps bleeding after the blade has moved on.
desc.id: Tebasan rendah yang terus berdarah setelah bilahnya berlalu.

desc.en: Bind the worst of it and keep standing. Restores health.
desc.id: Balut luka terparah dan tetap berdiri. Memulihkan darah.

desc.en: Fire pours out ahead in a widening fan.
desc.id: Api tercurah ke depan dalam kipas yang melebar.

desc.en: Cut behind the knee. What was chasing you now limps.
desc.id: Sayat di belakang lutut. Yang mengejarmu kini terpincang.

desc.en: For a short while every blow lands harder.
desc.id: Untuk sesaat, setiap pukulan mendarat lebih keras.

desc.en: The blade drinks, and some of what it drinks comes back to you as health.
desc.id: Bilah itu minum, dan sebagian yang diminumnya kembali padamu sebagai darah.

desc.en: Vanish in a puff of sparks and step out a few paces on.
desc.id: Lenyap dalam percikan bara dan muncul beberapa langkah di depan.
